meta.name: baoyu-diagram
meta.description: Create professional, dark-themed SVG diagrams of any type — architecture diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, structural diagrams, mind maps, timelines, illustrative/conceptual diagrams, and more. Use this skill whenever the user asks for any kind of technical or conceptual diagram, visualization of a system, process flow, data flow, component relationship, network topology, decision tree, org chart, state machine, or any visual representation of structure/logic/process. Also trigger when the user says "画个图" "画一个架构图" "diagram" "flowchart" "sequence diagram" "draw me a ..." or uploads content and asks to visualize it. Output is always a standalone .svg file.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任何系统或流程自动生成专业深色SVG图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速把复杂结构或流程变成清晰图表
copy.tagline_en: Generate professional dark-themed SVG diagrams from any system or process
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn complex structures or processes into clear diagrams

howto.what: 装上后,凡是要架构图、流程图、时序图等图表,Claude 会生成一张深色主题的独立 SVG 文件,样式和字体都内嵌;然后自动再导出一份 @2x 的 PNG,并把两个文件一起展示给你。
howto.when: 当你说“画个图”“diagram”“flowchart”这类词,或要求把架构、时序、流程等画成图,或上传内容并让它可视化时,本技能会被触发。

say.text: 帮我画个用户登录的流程图
say.note: Claude 会生成 SVG,并自动转成 @2x PNG。

say.text: 画一个订单系统的架构图
say.note: Claude 会调整布局并输出两种格式。

say.text: 把支付过程画成状态机图
say.note: 会标出状态节点与带标签的转移线。

howto.what_en: After installing, when you ask for architecture/flowchart/sequence or similar diagrams, Claude creates a dark-themed standalone SVG file (styles and fonts embedded), then auto-exports a @2x PNG and presents both files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say words like “画个图”, “diagram”, or “flowchart”, or ask to draw architecture, sequence, flow, etc., or upload content and ask to visualize it.

say_en.text: Draw a user-login flowchart for me.
say_en.note: Creates an SVG, then converts it to a @2x PNG.

say_en.text: Draw an architecture diagram of the order system.
say_en.note: Claude adjusts the layout and outputs both formats.

say_en.text: Draw the payment process as a state machine diagram.
say_en.note: State nodes and labeled transitions are shown.
